title: Docs Maintenance: Model + Agent primitives coherence sweep
description:
# Docs Maintenance: Model + Agent primitives coherence sweep

We need a repeatable way to keep **Tactus docs + examples + books + web** aligned as the language evolves (especially the Model + Agent primitives).

This epic is a maintenance follow-up to the original docs program (Tactus-84l).

## Scope (repos)
- ../Tactus-web
- ../Tactus-examples
- ../Learning-Tactus
- ../Tactus-in-a-Nutshell
- ../Programming-Tactus
- This repo (Tactus): canonical reference docs + SPECIFICATION.md

## Canon (must match everywhere)
- Model training config lives in `Model.training` (single Model block for training + runtime).
- CLI:
  - Train: `tactus train file.tac --model <name>`
  - Evaluate: `tactus models evaluate file.tac --model <name> [--version ... | --candidate ...]`
- Registry tags:
  - `latest`
  - `candidate/<candidate_name>`
- Canonical Model call pattern:
  - `local m = Model("name"); local r = m({ ... }); local out = r.output or r`
- Mocking story:
  - Specs should validate procedure logic.
  - `Mocks { ... }` provides deterministic, CI-safe tests.

## Plan (do in this order)
1) Inventory / drift scan
- In each repo, locate every snippet/paragraph that describes Models or Agents (and related CLI).
- Record exact file paths + what is stale + what to replace it with as notes on child beads.

2) Canon snippet pack
- Maintain a small set of copy/paste snippets that all repos should reuse (Model declaration, training CLI, evaluation CLI, mocks, runtime call pattern).
- Source of truth: `docs/model-primitive.md`, `docs/agent-primitive.md`, `SPECIFICATION.md` in this repo.

3) Outlines (holistic)
- For each repo, define what level of detail it should carry:
  - Web: conceptual + quickstart
  - Examples: runnable code + minimal narrative
  - Learning: guided tutorial + mental models
  - Nutshell: quick reference
  - Programming: deep reference
- Link across properties without contradicting semantics.

4) Implementation
- Make edits repo-by-repo, keeping terminology consistent and ensuring code snippets correspond to runnable examples.

5) QA pass
- Run examples test scripts in mock mode where available.
- Build Quarto books (Learning / Nutshell / Programming) to ensure no broken includes/snippets.

## Drift inventory (initial findings)
- Programming-Tactus: one heading still calls the HF trainer "Hugging Face AutoModel" even though the canonical name is "Hugging Face Sequence Classifier" (`hf_sequence_classifier`). Needs wording alignment.
